Platform Terms of Use

Corporate Governance

Read carefully the guidelines, limitations of clinical liability, and intellectual property rules applicable to the use of our tools.

1. Definitions
Site:
refers to the domain www.calculadorasdeenfermagem.com.br and all its subdomains and associated pages globally.

User:
any individual or legal entity that accesses or uses the site content and its extensions.

Tools / Calculators:
browser-based interactive applications that perform clinical calculations, scale scoring, and assessments based on input data provided exclusively by the active user.

Responsible Party:
Plataforma Cia de Enfermagem – primary contact via ciadeenfermagem@gmail.com.

2. Object of the Contract
These Terms are intended solely to regulate the use of the site and its embedded tools, which are made available entirely free of charge with an informative, educational, and consultative nature. The platform is primarily and exclusively aimed at licensed professionals and regular students in the health and medical sciences fields.

3. Eligibility and Restricted Use
The tools, algorithms, and scores made available here
are not intended for the lay public
in a self-diagnosis format. Proper use requires prior technical, anatomical, and pharmacological knowledge. The user declares, at the exact moment they access and interact with the site, that they have the necessary qualification and training to correctly interpret, filter, and apply the results presented in simulations or real nursing care scenarios.

4. User Rights and Obligations
The user assumes full and irrevocable commitment to the following guidelines when using the web applications:

Use the calculators and forms ethically, responsibly, and in accordance with professional practice recommended by professional bodies;

Rigorously validate and reassess the results obtained before any clinical decision-making, medication preparation, or physiological intervention;

Immediately notify the administrative responsible party of any systemic errors, logical flaws in calculations, or observed inconsistencies;

Not reverse engineer, reproduce, copy, scrape, distribute, or commercialize any fragment of the site content without prior documented authorization.

5. Full Disclaimer of Liability
The results, flowcharts, and matrices provided by our calculators and interactive scales are fundamentally structured and based on established formulas, validated literature (NANDA, NIC, NOC, WHO), and globally accepted protocols in emergency and intensive care.

However, all and any information generated must be strictly interpreted as
educational support or a secondary comparative reference to primary clinical reasoning
. Under no legal or medical justification should the web applications hosted here replace in-person, informed professional decision-making.

Absolute disclaimer:
The development team, technical administration, and platform maintainers
are not liable, whether in civil, criminal, or administrative spheres, for conduct or decisions made based on the results obtained.
We accept no responsibility for any injuries, iatrogenesis, medication errors, direct or indirect damages caused to third parties resulting from blind reliance or hasty use without professional audit of our tools.

6. Intellectual Property Protection
All structural content and visual content of the site — including, but not limited to: editorial texts, fluid layouts, image bank, corporate logos, code architecture, interactive scripts (JavaScript/Node), SVG vectors, and mathematical logic bases of the calculators — is the exclusive copyrighted property of Cia de Enfermagem Global Platform. These assets are duly protected by Brazilian legislation (Copyright and Industrial Property Law) and applicable international reciprocity treaties. Their partial or total reproduction for competitive or unlicensed pecuniary purposes is expressly prohibited.

7. Privacy Policy, Cookies, and LGPD
We are firmly committed to crystal-clear transparency and data privacy of our global audience. The site was designed using the premise of
Privacy by Design
. We do not require registrations for the calculators, we do not track personally identifiable information (PII) during care activities, and we use only
essential security cookies
and anonymous browsing statistics fragments (such as Analytics).

For an in-depth view of how we protect information within the ecosystem and in compliance with European principles and the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (Law No. 13.709/2018 - LGPD), please access our detailed
Official Privacy Policy
.

8. Multilateral Changes to the Terms
This legal document may be adjusted, expanded, revoked, or updated at any time necessary for governance improvement, without the need for individual dispatch or prior notice by correspondence. Central changes that impact clinical usability may, at the administration's discretion, be communicated in the form of non-intrusive alert bars
(banners)
within the pages.

Continued regular use of the site after indexing a new documented version legally implies unrestricted knowledge and full acceptance of the new revised terms.

9. Jurisdiction and Applicable Law
These contractual guidelines of Terms of Use are based and interpreted solely under the substantive legislation in force of the Federative Republic of Brazil. The involved parties solemnly elect the jurisdiction of the Central District of Santos, State of São Paulo, definitively waiving any other, however greater or more prominent, for the amicable, arbitral, or contentious resolution of any doubts, incidents, or interpretive disputes arising from this access commitment.

10. Contact Center and DPO
Our platform values continuous open communication with universities, hospitals, and the nursing public. To resolve any discrepancies, send requests related to digital rights protection, logical bug reports in care codes, or formal requests to the Data Protection Officer (DPO), please channel your request exclusively to the institutional electronic center indicated:
